function.name: client_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates of a single client based on the client's name and the status of the mandate. Partners can use this API to retrieve mandate information for their clients. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the client whose mandates are to be fetched.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If not specified, mandates with all statuses are retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches all mandates for all clients associated with a partner, filtered by the status of the mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of mandates to fetch. Possible values are 'active', 'pending', and 'inactive'.

function.name: partner_sips
function.description: Fetch all Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) of all clients associated with a partner, filtered by the given status of the SIP. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the SIPs to be fetched. Valid statuses include 'active', 'stopped', and 'paused'.

message.content:
A **mandate** in the context of financial services (especially in wealth management, investment advisory, or banking) refers to a formal authorization or instruction given by a client to a financial institution or advisor to act on their behalf in managing their investments or financial affairs. Key points about a mandate: | Aspect | Description | |--------|-------------| | **Purpose** | Grants the institution the authority to execute investment decisions, manage portfolios, or perform other financial tasks as agreed. | | **Types** | • **Active Mandate** – The client has approved the investment strategy and the advisor is actively managing the portfolio.
• **Pending Mandate** – The client has submitted the necessary documents or approvals, but the mandate is not yet fully activated.
• **Inactive Mandate** – The mandate has been terminated, paused, or is no longer in effect. | | **Components** | • Client’s name and details
• Mandate status (active, pending, inactive)
• Scope of authority (e.g., types of assets, risk tolerance, investment horizon) | | **Usage** | Partners or advisors can retrieve mandates for their clients via APIs (e.g., `client_mandates`, `partner_mandates`) to see which mandates are active, pending, or inactive. | In short, a mandate is the formal agreement that empowers a financial partner to manage a client’s investments according to agreed terms.
